description: Tanzania - Solar Radiation Measurement Data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Solar", published or maintained by Maria Vicenta Guisado Otero (World Bank Group). Repository for the measurements from the meteorological station located in Dar es Salaam (Tanzania). Data will be upload monthly. The measurements started on May 21st, 2015. Coverage: Tanzania. It has 2 files in CSV, ZIP. The portal files it under Solar. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
